LESSON: HEALTHY RELATIONSHIPS - EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATION - NEGOTIATION SKILLS - EMPATHY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.6: Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we promote healthy relationships in the community?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain ways of sustaining healthy relationships in the community

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HEALTHY RELATIONSHIPS - EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATION - NEGOTIATION SKILLS - EMPATHY
This lesson teaches Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy for Grade 9 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain ways of sustaining healthy relationships in the community
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy above.
2. Explain Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Healthy relationships - effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we promote healthy relationships in the community?

SECTION: REMEMBER
